cohorts.intended_user_task: Find the nearest maintained fuel reference, understand granularity/freshness, and calculate fill cost.
cohorts.asset_type: existing canonical tool upgraded to local data experience
cohorts.source_freshness_requirement: 45-day threshold; valid_to enforced; regulator preferred; national fallback labelled low confidence
cohorts.success_notes: Look for first clicks, improved near-me CTR, stable position, localized-result events and fill-cost completions.
cohorts.rollback_notes: Rollback if granularity is misrepresented, stale values show as current, raw location leaves the browser, or fill calculation fails.

cohorts.intended_user_task: Resolve an authority acronym to the correct jurisdiction and open the canonical country PAYE calculator.
cohorts.source_freshness_requirement: Authority registry reviewed with salary-tax official-source ledger; tax-year/status mirrors destination calculator
cohorts.success_notes: Measure acronym clicks, authority resolutions, ambiguity choices and calculator opens while country calculators retain query performance.
cohorts.rollback_notes: Remove the finder if it displaces canonical clicks without completed routing, guesses ambiguity, or drifts from official authority identity.

target_query_cluster: how many units for electricity amount
cohorts.intended_user_task: Choose a country, provider and customer class, then convert money to prepaid units or kWh to an estimated bill with source and freshness visible.
cohorts.asset_type: existing canonical tool upgraded to a provider-and-class data experience
cohorts.source_freshness_requirement: Exact official provider/class source; valid_to enforced when present; record-specific verification window; stale records fail closed; custom rate remains local-only
cohorts.review_date_rule: Set review_7_day, review_28_day and review_90_day by adding 7, 28 and 90 calendar days to deployment_date only after the production deploy receipt is verified.
cohorts.success_notes: Measure country/provider/class selections, source opens, supported and custom completions, CTR and route ownership while compatibility routes decline without losing completed electricity tasks.
cohorts.rollback_notes: Disable an automatic record if its provider, class, effective period or arithmetic is wrong; keep the custom-rate fallback and canonical route available.
